technique_name: Describe the benefits of using artificial intelligence for customer service.
description: Using artificial intelligence for customer service can bring numerous benefits. It can help to reduce the amount of time customers have to wait for their inquiries to be addressed, automate and speed up common customer service tasks, increase customer satisfaction, and enable a better insight into customer interactions.
